card.title: LES TERRIBLES
card.text: When you deploy another unit with operation cost 3 or more, draw a card.
card.flavorText: The 128th Infantry Regiment, nicknamed Les Terribles (the Terrifics in French), is a unit of the US Army which has been active since the American Civil War and has participated in many conflicts since then. In 1940, the 128th Regiment, as part of the 32nd Division, was sent to training in Louisiana, and then the unit was transported by convoy to Port Adelaide, Australia. From 1942 to 1944, the 128th achieved significant victories during various battles in the Pacific theater. They managed to break through Japanese lines at the Battle of Buna in New Guinea and defeated Japanese forces at Saidor and Aitape. In Leyte and Luzon they pierced through the Yamashita Line. The 32nd Division was still engaged in combat when the cease fire order came on 15 August 1945, and by then the division had been fighting for 654 days, which is more than any other US division in any war.
